title: Strategic Account Micro-Intake Workbench and Rapid-Admission Runway
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, structured micro-intake and adjudication workbench in the Console that lets PMs and AE/CS signals teams rapidly evaluate top-account escalations and either fast-admit them into roadmap slices or route them to staged review. The workbench will combine a deterministic signal score (revenue, renewal risk, technical risk, SLO impact, strategic fit) with an adjudication UI, peer-review workflow, and an automated runbook for commitments and follow-ups.
rationale: We receive high-velocity top-account asks that are currently funneled into a large, opaque backlog. This increases time-to-decision, causes missed SLAs for VIP customers, and reduces our ability to make objective trade-offs across cycles. A rapid-admit workbench standardizes inputs, surfaces decision rationale, and ties commitments to OKR/initiative capacity windows.
scope: Phase 1: micro-intake form + scoring service + adjudication UI + Linear automation rules for routing to rapid-admit OR standard review. Phase 2: experiment with admission budgets, SLA-backed commits, and console dashboards showing committed sprint capacity and signal drift.
out_of_scope: Full enterprise SLA contract changes, on-prem deployment of intake tooling, automated fiscal approvals for discounts — those will be handled by sales/legal processes outside this ticket.
success_metrics: Mean first-response time to VIP intake <= 3 business days
% of top-account requests admitted via rapid lane >= 30% without regressions
Reduction in backlog age for key accounts by 40% over quarter
Correlation between admission score and post-delivery NPS > 0.25
acceptance_criteria: Micro-intake form available in Console with required fields (account ARR, renewal date, severity, example use case, SLA ask)
Automated score computed within 2s for 95% of submissions
Workbench UI shows signal breakdown and allows two approvers with comment logging
Linear ticket auto-created with tags and priority based on route decision
Dashboard tile in Console surfaces admitted items, backlog age, and admitted-run vs fulfilled metric
tasks: Design micro-intake schema and validation rules (PM + Design)
Build adjudication workbench UI in Console (Frontend)
Linear automation rule to create PM ticket lanes and set priority (Platform)
Backfill historical requests to calibrate score thresholds (Data)
Create runbook for rapid-admit commitments and communication templates (CS + PM)
Instrument observability: latency, score distribution, admitted vs shipped tracking (Console)
Pilot with 5 strategic accounts during Cycle 41
notes: Trade-offs: strict scoring reduces manual review load but risks false negatives; plan to allow manual override with required rationale.
Decision: Phase 1 will prioritize visibility and SLA for intake; deeper integration with contract systems postponed to Phase 2.
Privacy: minimal PII collected in the form; ensure KMS policy for any customer-sensitive attachments.
Pilot acceptance threshold: target 70% accuracy vs historical PM decisions for fast-admit classification.
